required: collector remote-writes to the private production metrics backend
backend PromQL exposes all four required metric families
every production relay series carries environment=production, the opaque deployment ID, service=truyn-relay and an opaque region label
production relay series carry none of requestId, providerId or nodeId
truyn_runtime_ready for role=relay is observed with value 1
forbiddenPublicFields: Container Apps environment names or FQDNs

invariant: The relay /metrics listener must remain loopback-only. Production metric series must be distinguishable by bounded deployment identity labels only; requestId, providerId and nodeId remain log/trace correlation fields and must never be metric labels.
